bugs_found: compound_interest rejects positive rates and allows negative rates because the rate validation is inverted
compound_interest silently truncates non-integer years and compounds_per_year via int()
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer months via int()
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, allowing float/int mixing errors or inconsistent precision versus Account.balance
transfer mutates account_from before account_to, so an exception during crediting can leave balances inconsistent
fx_convert does not validate FX rate positivity, allowing zero or negative exchange rates
